policies.name: history_capture_anon_insert_phase1a_events
policies.withCheck: ((schema_version = 'history_capture.phase_1a.v1'::text) AND (phase = '1A'::text) AND (event_type = ANY (ARRAY['report_created'::text, 'report_cleared'::text])) AND (idempotency_key IS NOT NULL) AND (observed_at IS NOT NULL) AND (envelope IS NOT NULL) AND (payload IS NOT NULL) AND (metadata IS NOT NULL) AND (jsonb_typeof(envelope) = 'object'::text) AND (jsonb_typeof(payload) = 'object'::text) AND (jsonb_typeof(metadata) = 'object'::text))

policies.name: Allow anonymous feedback inserts
policies.withCheck: ((category IS NOT NULL) AND (length(TRIM(BOTH FROM category)) > 0) AND (char_length(category) <= 80) AND (message IS NOT NULL) AND (length(TRIM(BOTH FROM message)) > 0) AND (char_length(message) <= 4000) AND (COALESCE(status, 'new'::text) = 'new'::text))
